scientific_limitations_integrity: The result is over the complex numbers and concerns the non-torsion decomposable elliptic ruled surface at points off the two distinguished sections. It derives a new quantitative profile from a published exact Seshadri formula rather than replacing that formula. The infinite statement is proved algebraically; the bundled finite computation is supplementary. Literature and semantic searches leave a residual risk of an equivalent observation under different notation.
title: Exact volume-gap profile for Seshadri constants on a non-torsion elliptic ruled surface
